entries.title: Install rejects stale lockfile
entries.root_cause: package.json requires globby 14.0.2 while package-lock.json locks 13.2.2. Regenerate and commit the lockfile.

entries.title: Bundle exceeds runner memory
entries.root_cause: The atlas bundle build exhausts the runner's memory and is killed. Reduce its memory use or increase available memory.
